counterfactual_text: The bottle breaks into scattered glass pieces while still above the tile, and the pieces reach the floor afterward.
positive_text: The bottle falls continuously, visibly contacts the tile, fractures at impact, and the resulting glass pieces remain scattered.
semantic_text: A glass bottle falls onto a hard tile floor, breaks on impact, and its fragments remain scattered. Required visible entities: one intact glass bottle; one hard tile floor; visible vertical falling corridor. At the beginning: glass bottle: intact, uncracked, and elevated above the tile floor; tile floor: clear around the intended impact area. Required state changes: bottle position: elevated to tile floor; bottle integrity: intact to fractured; glass configuration: single bottle to scattered fragments. These event variables are allowed to change: bottle vertical position; bottle integrity; fragment count and spatial distribution. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; hard tile floor geometry; background and lighting; one glass bottle and its resulting fragments; one hard tile floor; the same impact area and camera view.
